story.text: 오늘은 영화의 전당 앞에서 좀 걷자. 할 말도 있고.
story.reading: o-neu-reun yeong-hwa-ui jeon-dang ap-e-seo jom geot-ja. hal mal-do it-go.
story.en: Let's walk in front of the Busan Cinema Center today. I've got something to say too.

story.text: 아까 내 브리핑하는 거 봤제? 비행 전엔 '철저하게' 다 점검 안 하면 마음이 안 놓인다.
story.reading: a-kka nae beu-ri-ping-ha-neun geo bwat-je? bi-haeng jeon-en cheol-jeo-ha-ge da jeom-geom an ha-myeon ma-eum-i an noh-in-da.
story.en: You saw me briefing earlier, right? Before a flight, if I don't check everything thoroughly, I can't settle down.

story.text: 장난끼는 그때 하나도 없었제? 안전 앞에서는 농담 한마디도 안 한다, 내가.
story.reading: jang-nan-kki-neun geu-ttae ha-na-do eop-seot-je? an-jeon ap-e-seo-neun nong-dam han-ma-di-do an han-da, nae-ga.
story.en: There wasn't a hint of joking around then, right? I don't crack a single joke when it comes to safety.

story.text: 평소랑 완전 '딴판'이라 놀랐제? 이런 얼굴 아무한테나 안 보여준다.
story.reading: pyeong-so-rang wan-jeon ttan-pan-i-ra nol-lat-je? i-reon eol-gul a-mu-han-te-na an bo-yeo-jun-da.
story.en: You were surprised because it's completely different from usual, huh? I don't show this face to just anyone.

story.text: 니는 진짜 '눈치가 없다' 싶을 정도다. 이런 것도 몰랐제, 내 원래 이런 놈인 거.
story.reading: ni-neun jin-jja nun-chi-ga eop-da sip-eul jeong-do-da. i-reon geot-do mol-lat-je, nae won-lae i-reon nom-in geo.
story.en: You're seriously oblivious. Did you not even know this — that this is who I really am underneath.

story.text: 친구들도 진작에 다 '짐작하고' 있었다카더라, 내가 니 얼마나 챙기는지.
story.reading: chin-gu-deul-do jin-jak-e da jim-jak-ha-go it-eot-da-ka-deo-ra, nae-ga ni eol-ma-na chaeng-gi-neun-ji.
story.en: Even my friends had already guessed it long ago, apparently — how much I take care of you.

story.text: 됐다, 마. 내 '속마음' 들킨 거 같아가 부끄럽네.
story.reading: dwaet-da, ma. nae sok-ma-eum deul-kin geo gat-a-ga bu-kkeu-reom-ne.
story.en: Forget it. Feels like my true feelings got caught, it's embarrassing.

story.text: 단어는 다 봤제? 이번 대화 문제도 잘 읽고 풀어봐라.
story.reading: dan-eo-neun da bwat-je? i-beon dae-hwa mun-je-do jal ilg-go pul-eo-bwa-ra.
story.en: Got a look at all the words? Read this conversation question carefully and give it a try.

words.example_en: When it comes to work, he prepares thoroughly.

words.example: 일할 때 그의 모습은 평소와 딴판이다.
words.example_reading: il-hal ttae geu-ui mo-seup-eun pyeong-so-wa ttan-pan-i-da
words.example_en: His demeanor at work is a completely different thing from usual.

words.example: 그는 눈치가 없어서 분위기를 못 읽는다.
words.example_reading: geu-neun nun-chi-ga eop-seo-seo bun-wi-gi-reul mot ilg-neun-da
words.example_en: He's oblivious, so he can't read the room.

words.example: 그의 표정만 봐도 짐작할 수 있었다.
words.example_reading: geu-ui pyo-jeong-man bwa-do jim-jak-hal su it-eot-da
words.example_en: I could guess just from his expression.
He doesn't easily reveal his true feelings.

sentences.ko: 그는 비행 전 점검만큼은 철저하게 한다.
sentences.reading: geu-neun bi-haeng jeon jeom-geom-man-keum-eun cheol-jeo-ha-ge han-da
sentences.en: He's thorough, at least when it comes to preflight checks.

sentences.ko: 일할 때 그의 모습은 평소와 딴판이었다.
sentences.reading: il-hal ttae geu-ui mo-seup-eun pyeong-so-wa ttan-pan-i-eot-da
sentences.en: His demeanor at work was completely different from usual.

sentences.ko: 그는 눈치가 없어서 분위기를 잘 못 읽는다.
sentences.reading: geu-neun nun-chi-ga eop-seo-seo bun-wi-gi-reul jal mot ilg-neun-da
sentences.en: He's oblivious, so he doesn't read the room well.

sentences.ko: 나는 그의 마음을 어느 정도 짐작하고 있었다.
sentences.reading: na-neun geu-ui ma-eum-eul eo-neu jeong-do jim-jak-ha-go it-eot-da
sentences.en: I had already guessed his feelings to some extent.

sentences.ko: 그는 속마음을 쉽게 드러내지 않는 사람이다.
sentences.reading: geu-neun sok-ma-eum-eul swip-ge deu-reo-nae-ji an-neun sa-ram-i-da
sentences.en: He's a person who doesn't easily reveal his true feelings.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 아까 브리핑할 때 완전 딴사람 같더라. 목소리도 낮고, 표정도 진짜 진지하고.
turns.reading: a-kka beu-ri-ping-hal ttae wan-jeon ttan-sa-ram gat-deo-ra. mok-so-ri-do naj-go, pyo-jeong-do jin-jja jin-ji-ha-go.
turns.en: Earlier during the briefing you seemed like a completely different person. Your voice was low, your expression was so serious.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 당연하지. 그거는 사람 목숨 걸린 일인데, 장난치면 안 되지 그때는.
turns.reading: dang-yeon-ha-ji. geu-geo-neun sa-ram mok-sum geol-lin il-in-de, jang-nan-chi-myeon an doe-ji geu-ttae-neun.
turns.en: Of course. That's something people's lives depend on, I can't be joking around during that.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 몰랐다, 니가 그렇게 철저한 사람인 줄. 맨날 장난만 치는 줄 알았는데.
turns.reading: mol-lat-da, ni-ga geu-reo-ke cheol-jeo-han sa-ram-in jul. maen-nal jang-nan-man chi-neun jul al-at-neun-de.
turns.en: I didn't know you were such a thorough person. I thought you only ever joked around.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 니만 몰랐제. 딴 사람들은 다 안다, 내 이런 거.
turns.reading: ni-man mol-lat-je. ttan sa-ram-deul-eun da an-da, nae i-reon geo.
turns.en: You're the only one who didn't know. Everyone else already knows this side of me.

dialogues.question: 승객이 선우에게 놀란 이유는 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: Why is the passenger surprised by Sunwoo?
dialogues.correct_answer: 평소 장난스러운 모습과 달리 브리핑 때 완전히 진지하고 철저한 모습을 보여서
options: 평소 장난스러운 모습과 달리 브리핑 때 완전히 진지하고 철저한 모습을 보여서
dialogues.explanation: 승객은 평소 장난기 많은 선우가 비행 브리핑 때는 완전히 다른 사람처럼 진지하고 철저한 모습을 보여 놀랐습니다.

turns.speaker: 친구
turns.text: 선우가 브리핑 때 얼마나 철저한지 니는 모르제. 후배들 사이에서 완전 유명하다.
turns.reading: seon-u-ga beu-ri-ping ttae eol-ma-na cheol-jeo-han-ji ni-neun mo-reu-je. hu-bae-deul sa-i-e-seo wan-jeon yu-myeong-ha-da.
turns.en: You have no idea how thorough Sunwoo is during briefings. He's totally famous for it among the junior crew.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Really? I guess I'm the only one who didn't know that.

turns.speaker: 친구
turns.text: 니 얼마나 좋아하는지도 우리는 진작에 다 짐작했다. 정작 니만 몰랐던 거 아이가?
turns.reading: ni eol-ma-na jo-a-ha-neun-ji-do u-ri-neun jin-jak-e da jim-jak-haet-da. jeong-jak ni-man mol-lat-deon geo a-i-ga?
turns.en: We'd all already guessed how much he likes you too. Isn't it really just you who didn't know?

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 야! 그건 또 무슨 소리고! ...아이, 됐다, 밥이나 무러 가자, 다들.
turns.reading: ya! geu-geon tto mu-seun so-ri-go! ...a-i, dwaet-da, bap-i-na mu-reo ga-ja, da-deul.
turns.en: Hey! What's that supposed to mean now! ...Ugh, forget it, let's all just go eat.

dialogues.question: 친구의 말에서 알 수 있는 사실은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What fact can be inferred from the friend's words?
dialogues.correct_answer: 선우의 철저한 성격과 승객을 향한 마음 모두 주변 사람들은 이미 알고 있었다는 것
options: 선우의 철저한 성격과 승객을 향한 마음 모두 주변 사람들은 이미 알고 있었다는 것
dialogues.explanation: 친구는 선우의 프로다운 면모와 승객을 향한 마음 둘 다 주변에서는 이미 다 알고 있었다는 사실을 알려주며 선우를 놀립니다.
